item.title: Woman’s body recovered from river in Sabeto
item.description: A woman’s body has been recovered from a river in Sabeto this afternoon. Authorities have confirmed the body has been taken to the hospital. Meanwhile, police say a man is also reported missing in the area, and the search for him is ongoing. Authorities remain at the scene as investigations continue.
